title: Can I MASTER King of the Hill Chess?
summary: Five online King of the Hill games vs ~1500-1650 humans; the four centre squares (the hill) are outlined on the board.
rules: Standard chess, plus: moving your king onto one of the four centre squares d4, e4, d5, e5 wins immediately (the move must be legal).
